source.notes: Exercises the product's own documented, vendor-neutral In-Page Push field contract; this derivative removes the bid entirely, so no carrier field is exercised at all.

specNotes: inpage: a valid no-bid response carries no in-page card; show the empty preview and do not invent bid-specific crosscheck successes.

An In-Page Push bid carries its creative in bid.ext, so the empty preview state for this format can only be reached where there is no bid at all — the dialect claims any bid whose ext carries a title-shaped or image-shaped field, and the preview renders exactly what the dialect claims (specs/029-preview-carrier-identity/contracts/inpage-push-preview.md).
Creative body classification follows specs/012 sections 1-2 independently of auction format validity. Original base provenance is retained; fixture bytes are synthetic.
